## Overview

Inspect A2A tasks (the Conductor fleet mirrors its runs into them) through the /api/a2a/tasks REST routes: list, history, detail and cancel.

## Authentication

All requests require a valid Bearer token or session cookie. Obtain a token via `POST /api/auth/login` or configure `REQUIRE_API_KEY=false` for local development.

## Endpoints

### GET /api/a2a/tasks

GET a2a › tasks

```bash
curl http://localhost:20128/api/a2a/tasks \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OMNIROUTE_TOKEN"
```

### POST /api/a2a/tasks

POST a2a › tasks

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:20128/api/a2a/tasks \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OMNIROUTE_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

### GET /api/a2a/tasks/{id}

GET a2a › tasks › <id>

```bash
curl http://localhost:20128/api/a2a/tasks/{id} \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OMNIROUTE_TOKEN"
```

### POST /api/a2a/tasks/{id}/cancel

POST a2a › tasks › <id> › cancel

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:20128/api/a2a/tasks/{id}/cancel \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OMNIROUTE_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

## Payloads

See the full OpenAPI specification at `GET /api/openapi/spec` or `docs/openapi.yaml` for detailed request/response schemas.

# OmniRoute — A2A Tasks

Requires `OMNIROUTE_URL` and `OMNIROUTE_KEY`. See [entry-point SKILL](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute/main/skills/omni-auth/SKILL.md) for setup.

67router no longer serves the A2A JSON-RPC endpoint or an Agent Card. What remains is the
local task store the Conductor fleet mirrors its runs into, readable over REST:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $OMNIROUTE_KEY" "$OMNIROUTE_URL/api/a2a/tasks?limit=20"
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $OMNIROUTE_KEY" "$OMNIROUTE_URL/api/a2a/tasks/history?limit=50"
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $OMNIROUTE_KEY" "$OMNIROUTE_URL/api/a2a/tasks/<id>"
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OMNIROUTE_KEY" "$OMNIROUTE_URL/api/a2a/tasks/<id>/cancel"
```
<!-- skill:custom-end -->
